name: autovoyage
description: 云程 AutoVoyage · 汽车信息管理系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @autovoyage/api" "npm run dev -w @autovoyage/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @autovoyage/api && npm run build -w @autovoyage/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
